usage: The word '沙嗲牛河' refers to a specific dish, consisting of satay-flavored beef and ho fun noodles.
'沙嗲牛河' is used as a noun to name this dish on menus and when ordering food.
You can use '沙嗲牛河' in sentences when talking about what you want to eat or recommend a meal.
This word is usually not combined with other nouns, as it simply refers to this particular dish.
In conversation, you can ask if the restaurant has '沙嗲牛河' or say you want to order '沙嗲牛河'.
